title: Deep Auditory Models with Temporal Modulation Constraints Reveal the Emergence of Human-like Music Selectivity
authors: H Kim, S-B Paik, KM Lee
teaser: How do temporal constraints shape music-selective representations?
overview: This project investigates how spectrotemporal modulation constraints can give rise to human-like cortical music selectivity in deep auditory models.

title: Brain Alignment of Music Foundation Models: Do Better Representations Mirror the Auditory Cortex?
teaser: Connecting music representations to the auditory cortex.
overview: This project investigates representational alignment between deep audio models and human brain responses, asking how representations in music foundation models relate to those in the auditory cortex.

title: Neural Correlates of Immersive Spatial Audio: Enhanced Neural Synchrony and Reduced Late Cortical Responses During Naturalistic Listening
authors: H Kim, R Sato, S Kim, KM Lee
teaser: Understanding immersive listening through human brain responses.
overview: This project uses human EEG and naturalistic listening to investigate the neural correlates of immersive spatial audio.

title: Transferable Audio Lottery Tickets: Gradient Accumulation for Extreme Sparsity
authors: H Kim, J Nam, KM Lee
teaser: Exploring sparse and transferable audio models.
overview: A study of gradient accumulation for extreme sparsity in audio models, presented at the IEEE International Conference on Acoustics, Speech and Signal Processing.

title: Musical Emotion Under Cochlear Implant Listening: Human Perception and Foundation Model Representations of Human-Composed and AI-Generated Music
authors: T Song, H Kim, KM Lee
teaser: Musical emotion across human perception and model representations.
overview: This work examines musical emotion under cochlear implant listening, considering human perception and foundation model representations of human-composed and AI-generated music.

title: Gender Bias and Sonic Gender Performance in AI-Generated Music: Representation, Expression, and Perception
authors: M Bae, H Kim, KM Lee
teaser: Examining representation and perception in AI-generated music.
overview: This work examines gender bias and sonic gender performance in AI-generated music through representation, expression, and perception.

title: Predicting Music Preference Using Deep Learning on Electroencephalogram and Audio Features
authors: S Cho, H Kim, KM Lee
venue: The Journal of the Acoustical Society of Korea · 2026
teaser: Bringing together EEG and audio to study music preference.
overview: This work explores the prediction of music preference using deep learning with electroencephalogram and audio features.

title: Which audio features can predict the dynamic musical emotions of both composers and listeners?
authors: EJ Oh, H Kim, KM Lee
teaser: Relating audio features to changing musical emotions.
overview: This work investigates audio features for predicting the dynamic musical emotions of composers and listeners.

title: Enhancing Predictive Models of Music Familiarity with EEG: Insights from Fans and Non-fans of K-pop Group NCT127
authors: S Park, H Kim, KM Lee
overview: This work explores predictive models of music familiarity using EEG, considering fans and non-fans of K-pop group NCT127.

title: Fast frequency discrimination and phoneme recognition using a biomimetic membrane coupled to a neural network
authors: WS Lee, H Kim, AN Cleland, KH Ahn
teaser: Linking a physical model of hearing with neural networks.
overview: This work couples a biomimetic membrane to a neural network for frequency discrimination and phoneme recognition.

title: Origin of the higher difficulty in the recognition of vowels compared to handwritten digits in deep neural networks
authors: H Kim, WS Lee, J Yoo, M Park, KH Ahn
venue: Journal of the Korean Physical Society, 74, 12–18 · 2019
teaser: Comparing speech and visual recognition in deep networks.
overview: This work investigates differences in the difficulty of recognizing vowels and handwritten digits using deep neural networks.
